problems.title: Your Website Looks Outdated
problems.body: An outdated website can make a professional business appear less credible and can make it harder for customers to understand what you offer.

problems.title: Customers Struggle on Mobile
problems.body: A large part of your audience may discover your business from a phone. A poor mobile experience can create unnecessary friction before someone contacts you.

problems.title: Visitors Do Not Know What to Do Next
problems.body: A website can look attractive and still fail to generate enquiries when the content, navigation and calls to action are unclear.

problems.title: Your Website Loads Slowly
problems.body: Large assets, unnecessary scripts and inefficient implementation can create slow experiences that frustrate users and hurt engagement.

problems.title: Your Website Is Difficult to Grow
problems.body: A website should be able to evolve with your business. We focus on structures that allow new pages, features and integrations to be added later.

faqs.question: How long does website development take?
faqs.answer: The timeline depends on the number of pages, design requirements, integrations and functionality. After understanding your requirements, we can provide a clearer project scope and estimated timeline.

faqs.question: Can you redesign my existing website?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can review an existing website and improve its visual design, structure, mobile experience, performance and overall customer journey.

faqs.question: Will my website work on mobile devices?
faqs.answer: Yes. Responsive behaviour is considered throughout the design and development process so the experience works across phones, tablets and desktop screens.

faqs.question: Can you integrate APIs and third-party services?
faqs.answer: Yes. Where the required service provides suitable integration options, we can connect your website with APIs, communication tools, analytics platforms and other business systems.

faqs.question: Will the website be SEO friendly?
faqs.answer: We build with SEO foundations such as clean structure, responsive layouts, metadata and performance considerations. Ongoing SEO strategy and content marketing can be handled as a separate requirement.

faqs.question: Can new features be added later?
faqs.answer: Yes. We aim to create maintainable and scalable foundations so additional pages, integrations and functionality can be introduced as your business grows.

faqs.question: Can you help after the website goes live?
faqs.answer: Yes. Post-launch support and future improvements can be discussed according to the project's requirements.
